name: Prestige Lakeside Habitat
summary: Large integrated township in Whitefield with lake views, clubhouse, and multiple towers. Well-established society with consistent maintenance. Prestige Group brand provides builder confidence.
common_complaints: Traffic congestion on exit road during peak hours
Maintenance fees on the higher side
review_summary: Residents consistently rate the society highly for maintenance quality and amenities. Primary concern is peak-hour traffic on Varthur Road.

name: Brigade Metropolis
summary: One of Whitefield's older premium townships. Brigade Group pedigree. Slightly aged infrastructure compared to newer developments but strong community and lower prices.
common_positives: Lower maintenance costs than newer societies
common_complaints: Waterlogging in basement during heavy rains
review_summary: Good value society with a strong community feel. Infrastructure age is the main downside. Newer buyers should inspect plumbing and lifts before purchase.

name: Sobha Dream Acres
summary: Sobha's largest Bengaluru township. High construction quality — Sobha is known for in-house construction rather than outsourcing. Compact apartment sizes but premium finishes.
common_positives: Sobha construction quality — superior to many peers
common_complaints: Compact carpet areas despite super builtup claims
Very large complex — traffic at gates
review_summary: High resident satisfaction with construction quality. Compact unit sizes are the most repeated concern. Strong builder trust.

name: Salarpuria Sattva Cadenza
summary: Mid-premium society on Sarjapur Road corridor. Good location for IT employees in Bellandur and Electronic City. Salarpuria Sattva has consistent quality track record.
common_positives: Good commute to Bellandur tech parks
common_complaints: Sarjapur Road traffic is a persistent issue
review_summary: Strong society overall. Location is the primary consideration — works well for those working in the Sarjapur-Bellandur corridor.

name: Brigade Orchards
summary: Large integrated township on Sarjapur Road. Mix of apartments and villas. Good amenities, newer infrastructure. Under construction units still available alongside ready resales.
common_positives: Township amenities including school and retail
review_summary: Popular for IT families. Integrated township feel is a strong positive. Distance from metro is the main tradeoff.

name: Prestige Falcon City
summary: Prestige Group's premium integrated township on Kanakapura Road / Sarjapur corridor. Large-format amenities. Strong demand from families looking for premium living.
review_summary: Premium end of the Sarjapur corridor market. Good for long-term residents who value amenities and Prestige brand.

name: Salarpuria Sattva Magnus
summary: Well-regarded society in Bellandur. Good proximity to Outer Ring Road and major tech parks. Salarpuria Sattva quality. Premium pricing for the area.
common_positives: Close to major IT offices — Eco Space, RMZ
common_complaints: Bellandur lake proximity — odour concerns during summer
review_summary: Strong choice for professionals working on ORR. Bellandur lake odour is a real seasonal concern — worth visiting the site in summer before buying.

name: Total Environment Windmills of Your Mind
summary: Boutique premium apartment complex by Total Environment — known for exceptional green design and architect-quality interiors. Low unit count means strong community. Niche but highly regarded.
common_positives: Small community — very personal and well-managed
High resale demand from design-conscious buyers
review_summary: Consistently one of the most loved societies in Bengaluru for residents who can afford it. Quality and community are the standout attributes.
future_google_place_name: Total Environment Windmills of Your Mind

name: Mantri Webcity
summary: Established large township in HSR Layout. Good location in one of Bengaluru's most sought-after residential areas. Slightly older infrastructure. Mantri brand has mixed reviews in Bengaluru.
common_complaints: Mantri after-sales service has been inconsistent historically
Some litigation history — verify documents carefully
review_summary: Location is the primary advantage. Due diligence on legal documents is strongly recommended given some past Mantri project issues.

name: Sobha Garnet
summary: Smaller Sobha project in HSR Layout. Premium finishes, strong construction quality. Lower unit count than Sobha Dream Acres — more intimate community feel.
review_summary: High satisfaction. Strong choice for buyers who prioritise quality and location over amenity scale. Priced at a premium even for HSR.

name: Prestige Northpoint
summary: Prestige project in Hebbal — North Bengaluru's growing residential zone. Good connectivity to airport and Manyata Tech Park. Some airport noise depending on flight paths.
common_positives: Good price vs South Bengaluru equivalents
common_complaints: Airport noise on some floors and facings
North Bengaluru still developing — fewer retail options
Commute to South Bengaluru tech parks is long
review_summary: Good option for professionals at Manyata or who travel frequently. Airport noise is real — visit at different times of day and ask about specific tower exposure before buying.

name: Brigade Northridge
summary: Brigade project in Yelahanka, one of North Bengaluru's more established neighbourhoods. Good schools and retail access. Airport connectivity is a consistent positive.
common_positives: Good schools nearby — Ryan International and others
Yelahanka is more established than Hebbal
common_complaints: Long commute to Electronic City or Whitefield
Some airport noise on upper floors
review_summary: Popular with families valuing schools and a quieter neighbourhood. Not ideal for professionals commuting to South or East Bengaluru tech corridors.
